results.title: Policy Statement Concerning the Suppression of Accuracy in Artificial Intelligence Systems
results.abstract: The Federal Trade Commission ("Commission") is proposing a policy statement regarding the application of the prohibition on deceptive acts or practices in section 5 of the Federal Trade Commission Act to companies that market artificial intelligence ("AI") systems.
